reference: docs/temp/paint-references/PLAN.md, Classic View menu: actual Thumbnail toggle with checked/disabled state. Floating body follows shared Classic conventions; no pinned native Thumbnail geometry.
scope: View Thumbnail is a Classic-only, open-document toggle shared by egui/native-menu routing. A movable/resizable themed window fits the complete committed canvas with alpha checkerboard and cropped partial-edge UVs. Close releases its image. No document command, save, preference write or text commit is implied.
resource_boundary: One optional native CPU worker and one queued job, at most 256x256 output, 8 MiB declared scratch plus conservatively charged source raster tiles with a 1 GiB local cap. Output frame/ColorImage/texture allowance of 12 bytes per sample is admitted before scheduling and retained through transfer to the UI cache. A 2x2 repeated checkerboard per theme bounds presentation geometry. Source change/hiding cancels and drains; an old job cannot publish for another document/state. Hidden in-flight work keeps its charges until completion; interactive gestures/pending edits defer new overview admission. These are logical bounds, not a physical-RSS or latency qualification.
